misconceptions: Applying an operation to only one side changes the solution set.
Discarding measurement units or integer constraints leads to incorrect contextual conclusions.
A correct final number alone does not justify an invalid intermediate step.
interventions: Use a paired-column equality-preserving step chart.
Offer a second worked contextual model with units labeled.
extensions: Invent an equivalent equation and prove it has the same solution set.
